name: Click Indicator
description: Shows your own image in the corner while you click or hold, so you don't need a handcam.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Show the click indicator in levels.

size.name: Size
size.description: Height of the indicator as a percentage of the screen height. Applies the next time you enter a level.

margin.name: Margin
margin.description: Gap from the bottom-right corner, as a percentage of the screen height. Applies the next time you enter a level.

opacity.name: Opacity
opacity.description: Opacity of the indicator in percent. Applies the next time you enter a level.
